description: This file defines the class HTML_Template_Flexy_Compiler_Regex_SimpleTags, which provides methods for processing template strings with custom syntax, including variable replacements, method calls, loops, conditionals, and includes, for the HTML_Template_Flexy templating system.

classes.name: HTML_Template_Flexy_Compiler_Regex_SimpleTags
